claims.text: The baselines for the speculation detection and scope resolution tasks were established using the models BERT, XLNet, and RoBERTa, evaluated on datasets BF, BA, and SFU.
The default train-validation-test split for each dataset was 70-15-15, which was used to evaluate the models' performance.
The results reported for the models were averaged across multiple runs to ensure statistical significance.
